own.reason: Fix moves self.__receipts[receipt]=None inside the condition lock before notify() in __notify(receipt); previously notify fired before the receipt was recorded, so the waiter in send() could re-check, miss it and wait forever. Finding 0 names exactly this lost wake-up in send/__notify. Findings 1 (heartbeats[1]=0 timeout) and 2 (None __socket) are unrelated to the diff.

Fix changes the HeartbeatListener loop exit test from self.running to heartbeat_terminate_event, closing a race where a reconnect flips running back to True before the old loop observes it. Finding 0 names the same window (reconnect before the old heartbeat loop exits) on the same loop, but asserts a different effect (no live loop) than the one the diff implies (old loop survives the stop). Finding 1 blames a stale terminate event, i.e. the mechanism the fix adopts, not the running flag; findings 2-4 are socket/keepalive issues outside the diff.
